text.p01: To those who can’t take it like Etoo A story about managing Anger
text.p03: In the middle of a hot, sandy desert, lived a tiny beetle named Etoo and a buzzing bee named Bella.
text.p04: They were the best of friends, always exploring the desert dunes together.
text.p05: They climp over cactus plants, shared drops of sweet nectar, and rested under cool rocks when the sun was too hot
text.p06: One scorching afternoon, Etoo was building a small sand tower
text.p07: While Bella gathered nectar from nearby flowers.
text.p08: But when Bella zoomed by, her wings made a gust of wind that knocked Etoo’s sand tower down.
text.p10: “I didn’t mean to!” Bella buzzed back.
text.p11: “It was just the wind from my wings!”
text.p12: But Etoo was too angry to listen.
text.p13: “You always ruin everything!” he snapped and stomped away, his tiny legs kicking up dust.
text.p14: Bella felt hurt and flew off to a tall cactus, her wings drooping.
text.p15: The hot desert felt even lonelier without Etoo’s laughter.
text.p16: Later, Etoo sat under a rock, his face still scrunched with anger.
text.p17: But soon, he noticed how quiet and empty it felt without Bella.
text.p18: Etoo thought about how much fun they always had
text.p19: He realized that being angry wasn’t making him feel better.
text.p20: He took a deep breath, just like the desert breeze after a sandstorm.
text.p21: He remembered what the wise old scorpion once said, “When anger buzzes loud, pause and listen to your heart.”
text.p23: When he did, he saw her quietly sitting by the cactus.
text.p24: “Bella,” Etoo said softly, “I’m sorry I got so mad.
text.p25: I know you didn’t mean to knock down my tower.”
text.p27: “I’m sorry too. I didn’t mean to upset you.”
text.p29: “Let’s build the biggest sand tower together!” Bella shouted.
text.p30: From that day on, Etoo learned that when he felt angry, taking a deep breath helped him cool down
text.p31: just like the desert wind after a hot day. And everything will be alright again.
